description: DEV-ONLY. Window management for the automated test bridge (surfaces/gui/src/testbridge.ts). The shipped capability set deliberately does NOT let the webview resize, move, or full-screen its own window — that is correct, and this file must never be merged into `default.json`. It is gated to debug builds by `platforms` + the `#[cfg(debug_assertions)]` guard in lib.rs, and the bridge that uses it is stripped from production bundles by Vite.
